The convex cone of a finite positive balanced fan equals its linear span and admits strictly positive rational relations on all chosen generators. Continuous rational-endpoint PC functions obey a componentwise maximum principle in precise balanced local charts; compact connected continuous competitors are constants. A finite bounded rational cell decomposition yields a rational constant literal-PA envelope with zero positive-dimensional raw divisor/contact; finite dimension-zero spaces retain the zero-fold weighted cycle and have zero gap. Printed rational-endpoint Jensen inequalities alone admit f=0 on Q and -1 off Q, contradicting automatic continuity. No unrestricted competitor or noncompact classification closure.
